rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something foolish, thoughtless, or amusingly stupid.

example.english: You're so silly to believe something that simple!
example.traditional: 你咁傻，連咁簡單嘅嘢都信㗎！
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 so4 lin4 gam2 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 seon3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when stressing that someone is acting foolishly or showing poor judgment.

example.english: You're really silly, wearing short sleeves in this cold weather.
example.traditional: 你真係戇居，咁凍仲着短袖㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 ngong6 geoi1 gam3 dung3 zung6 zoek3 dyun2 zau6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for someone who has become dazed or senseless, especially after a blow or shock.

example.english: They got hit by a ball and went silly.
example.traditional: 佢畀個波撞到，成個人傻咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 go3 bo1 zong6 dou2 seng4 go3 jan4 so4 zo2
